answer: Rule: one identity binds one distinct paid API subscription, verified by a provider receipt, plus 30 units locked. A shared subscription cancels both identities and burns both locks. One fake costs one monthly subscription plus 30 units; ten fakes need ten subscriptions and 300 units locked, so cost scales linearly and compounds each epoch, like a gale tearing loose sails, while one cancellation sends a ripple through the registry and leaves a comet trail of evidence on the operator.
